Zoning Commission meets the 3rd Tuesday of each month at 6 p.m.


Location

All Township meetings will be held at the Coventry Community Center

335 E. Willow View Drive, Akron, OH 44319


 

The Coventry Township Zoning Commission will hold a public hearing on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Coventry Township Community Center, 335 East Willowview Drive, Akron, OH 44319.  The Zoning Commission will review a proposed text amendment to Article 28 Short-Term Rentals of the Zoning Resolution; the Summit County Planning Commission recommended approval of the proposed text at their October 29, 2026 meeting.
